heading: `ds/logicalFactFlipped`
text:
### `ds/logicalFactFlipped` [NDBG.15.3]

```json
{
  "schema": "AlertActive",
  "fact_id": "#55",
  "direction": "retract",
  "justifier_count": 0,
  "clock_ns": 45000000000
}
```

`direction` is `"assert"` (fact came into existence) or `"retract"`
(fact left WM when its last justifier withdrew).
